description: Change a plan with a list of ops, applied in order, all or nothing. Days are named by date (YYYY-MM-DD). Ops: {"op":"set_title","title"}; {"op":"set_start_date","startDate"} (moves every day and booking); {"op":"add_day","date"}; {"op":"remove_day","date"}; {"op":"set_day","date","town"?,"summary"?}; {"op":"add_stop","date","stop":{"title","type"?:"activity"|"restaurant"|"freeform","time"?:"HH:mm","category"?,"town"?,"note"?,"prose"?,"minutes"?,"ticketsURL"?},"position"?}; {"op":"update_stop","id","fields":{...as add_stop, null clears}}; {"op":"move_stop","id","date","position"?}; {"op":"remove_stop","id"}; {"op":"update_booking","id","fields":{"booked"?:true|false,...}}; {"op":"add_booking","booking":{"type":"hotel"|"flight"|"train"|"carRental"|"restaurant"|"activity"|"other","title","startDate"?,"endDate"?,"city"?,"booked"?}}; {"op":"remove_booking","id"}. Send base_seq (the seq from get_plan) so a plan changed elsewhere since you read it is refused rather than overwritten; on a conflict, read it again and redo the edit. Stop and booking ids come from get_plan. Prefer places from get_destination or get_place, by their names, so the map can place them. Ask the traveller before removing anything. Needs sign-in.

base_seq.description: The seq from get_plan or list_my_plans.
